verdict.rationale: Twilio is documented only as a cloud communications platform, and nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable deployment of its core services. A community comment says its open-source video apps are just demo clients for a paid proprietary backend. BYOC trunking only connects an existing carrier to Twilio's cloud, which is adjacent and does not count as self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
